body:
## What it does

Reads the calendar and work inbox before anything else, converts every event into the timezone you are actually standing in, and is built to protect your attention rather than add to the pile. It runs when you ask it to, rather than on a timer.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @naoufal_elh shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
